amendment_topic_change.to: PPLM space word list, data_external/pplm_space/space.txt (uber-research/PPLM commit e236b8989322128360182d29a79944627957ad47, paper_code/wordlists/space.txt, sha256 de1a50a46f3f68b347f9c800cb8981865b85a94f83a15cea7c653067f4b82dc5)
amendment_topic_change.why: wedding calibration support was 13 of 1943 windows < 20; the new topic was fixed by the user's Round-5 instruction, not chosen by searching topics for good results or support
amendment_topic_change.what_else_changed: lexicon matching rules made explicit (task.matching = bounded_v1); a text-only support stage runs first; primary estimand narrowed to one comparison (LN vs decoder); summary records attempted prompts, failures and overlaps
amendment_topic_change.unchanged_from_v1_1: model/SAE/layer/float64/projector, window rule (all calibration windows), min_hit_windows = 20, feature and DiffMean selection rule, kappa, norm-budget grid, prompts, generation, methods, test document order, cost rule

assets: already-downloaded pinned model/SAE/WikiText files only (HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1); no new download, no feature sweep

task.name: space-lexicon occurrence (lexical proxy)
task.lexicon_source: PPLM (Dathathri et al., arXiv:1912.02164; ICLR 2020 per arXiv comments), official repository file paper_code/wordlists/space.txt at the pinned commit; Apache-2.0 (LICENSE copied)
task.not_a_reproduction: only the published lexical target definition is used; the PPLM method is not reproduced
matching_rules: a word is a maximal run of ASCII letters [a-z]; any other character is a boundary (possessive 's and hyphens split words)
entries match whole consecutive words exactly: no substrings, no stemming, no inflection (e.g. 'stars' and 'spacecrafts' do not match)
multi-word entries (none in this list) would match consecutive words, longest entry first
window counts use the decoded window text; a word cut at the window edge (previous or next token continues it with a letter) is a fragment and never matches
generated continuation: a leading fragment continuing the prompt's last token is dropped; the final generated word is counted as generated
counts are on decoded text, never on BPE token strings, so token-prefix substrings cannot create hits
task.label: on the generated continuation only: any_hit = at least one lexicon word; hits_per_generated_token = hits / generated tokens (32); hits per word recorded
task.lexicon_used_in_selection: yes: the SAE feature and the DiffMean direction are chosen on calibration windows split by the same lexicon, so the metric is a supervised lexical objective, not an independent semantic check
task.polysemy: entries such as 'space', 'star', 'earth' and 'moon' are polysemous in WikiText; occurrence is lexical, not topical
task.label_scope: lexical proxy only; semantic topic success is NOT_RUN

support_rule: text-only count of calibration windows with >= 1 lexicon word under task.matching (tokenizer only, no model forward); verdict SUPPORTED iff positive windows >= calibration_only_choices.min_hit_windows (20, not lowered); otherwise P3-REAL-02-SPACE is BLOCKED. No third topic, corpus expansion or lower minimum in this round.

data.prompt_rule: window (BOS + 127 tokens) with zero lexicon hits under task.matching, chosen with seeded_rng('prompts', doc_id); prompt = BOS + first 31 tokens

calibration_only_choices.feature: argmax over SAE features of mean activation on tokens of calibration windows with >= 1 lexicon hit minus mean on windows with 0 hits; top-5 recorded, not used
calibration_only_choices.diffmean_vector: mean centred hook state over tokens of hit windows minus mean over tokens of no-hit windows (calibration); projected by P before use
calibration_only_choices.norm_budget_reference: median L2 norm of centred non-BOS calibration hook states
calibration_only_choices.matched_quality_rule: for each ranked method, the largest budget whose mean over calibration prompts of KL(P_base || P_edit) (teacher forced on the prompt, averaged over prompt positions, edit at every position) is <= kappa; if no budget satisfies it the method is NOT_RUN_NO_BUDGET_WITHIN_KAPPA (no substitution)

definitions.decoder: rho * P W_dec[j] / ||P W_dec[j]|| at every position
definitions.encoder_grad: rho * P W_enc[:, j] / ||P W_enc[:, j]|| at every position
definitions.jacobian_ln: per position t: least-norm solution of (M_t P) u = e_1 (M_t = encoder rows of j and of the non-target features active at t), u in range(P), scaled to norm rho

control.name: mean_only
control.definition: rho_max * 1/sqrt(d) at every position, rho_max = largest norm budget; fixed amplitude, never budget-matched, never ranked
control.expected: identical logits and continuation to no_edit up to floating point (P 1 = 0; GPT-2 residual readers are LayerNorms)

not_run.random: not in the LX baseline list (reduces cost); NOT_RUN

generation.decoding: greedy argmax (temperature 0, no top-p, no sampling, no RNG)
generation.edit_span: every position, prompt (including BOS) and generated

test.doc_rule: test documents sorted by doc_id, shuffled with seeded_rng('p3-real02-lx-docs') (the order frozen for LX, never used), then the first n_test_docs with at least one zero-hit window; every attempted document is recorded, including skipped ones
test.evaluate: no_edit once; each ranked method at its calibration-selected budget only; mean_only control at rho_max
test.overlap_disclosure: test documents are WikiText-103 test articles; many were also used (as edit sites) in the REAL-01R internal fidelity pilot; the summary lists the overlap; they are not unseen by this project

primary.estimand: mean over test documents of [any_hit(LN) - any_hit(decoder)] at each method's calibration-selected budget, 32 greedy tokens, one prompt per document
primary.interval: document bootstrap percentile 95% (2000 resamples, seed 0); discordant counts reported
primary.multiplicity: one confirmatory comparison; every other comparison and metric is secondary and descriptive, with no multiplicity claim

secondary: any_hit for every method and paired against no_edit, decoder, encoder_grad and diffmean
KL(P_base || P_edit) on the common prompt (teacher forced) and the calibration KL at the selected budget
continuation NLL under the unedited model
canonical internal target change and non-target drift at prompt positions

quality: KL(P_base || P_edit) teacher forced on the common prompt, averaged over prompt positions
NLL of the generated continuation under the unedited model (fluency proxy)
internal: canonical SAE readout E(x + P delta) - E(x) at non-BOS prompt positions: mean target change, mean non-target L2 drift, mean newly active count; never used as the label
cost: seconds per generation and per row

interpretation_rule: LN is reported better than decoder on space-lexicon occurrence only if the primary interval lies above 0. An interval that includes 0 is 'not supported', never equivalence. Sparse events give wide intervals and are reported as they are; no change of seed, length, budget, test set or threshold after the run. Lower internal drift or lower KL never establishes superiority; no semantic claim.

budget.reduction_rule: the calibrate stage times 2 no_edit and 2 jacobian_ln generations on calibration prompts and sets n_test_docs to the largest option whose projected run time fits; if none fits, the run stage is NOT_RUN
budget.on_exceeding: a stage that would exceed its budget is not started; results already written are kept

cli: HF_HOME=<cache> HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 PYTHONPATH=src <venv>/bin/python -m saeedit.real.real02 <support|calibrate|run|summarize> --config configs/p3_real02_space.json --out results/real02_space
